name: KIC 10547065
description: A red-clump giant burning helium in its core in the Kepler field, 14.9 solar radii and 2.61 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 10547065 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 14.9286 +/- 0.2772

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 10547065 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 2.6112 +/- 0.1074

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 10547065 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4753.673 +/- 49.6099

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 10547065 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.5096 +/- 0.0043

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the color routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red-clump giant in the Kepler field, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 2.61 solar masses and 14.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,754 K at its surface.
